title: Upload a leaf photo
description: Drag and drop a photo here, or choose one from your device.
hint: JPG or PNG · up to 10 MB · one leaf, clear and close-up

errors.unsupportedFormat: Only JPG and PNG photos are supported.
errors.tooLarge: This photo is larger than 10 MB. Please choose a smaller one.
